Fixes https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/9846

issue_context.title: Panic in WAL replay
issue_context.body:
This is related to #9841. Let's say we encounter the situation described in #9841 because of some misconfiguration, we can face panic because of below scenario:

1. The samples record is read first, and it goes ahead to add the sample to the series [here](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/f08c89e569b2421bcc8ef7caf585fd8d3c2ccaba/tsdb/head_wal.go#L386).
2. The series record is seen next, and the series get's created [here](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/f08c89e569b2421bcc8ef7caf585fd8d3c2ccaba/tsdb/head_wal.go#L205-L221).
3. Since both records are processed in parallel, it can happen that though samples record was seen first, series gets created first before the sample is appended [here](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/f08c89e569b2421bcc8ef7caf585fd8d3c2ccaba/tsdb/head_wal.go#L407)

Now comes the race that causes panic:

1. When series is created, we set the m-map chunks [here](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/f08c89e569b2421bcc8ef7caf585fd8d3c2ccaba/tsdb/head_wal.go#L219). This assumes that no sample append will be in parallel.
2. At the same time, the sample append tries to access the mmapped chunks [here](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/f08c89e569b2421bcc8ef7caf585fd8d3c2ccaba/tsdb/head_append.go#L485).

Due to changing slice, the access of the slice can panic. (We faced this at Grafana Labs)

review_comments: I would add a comment to explain why we do it after draining the inputs above.
